m: सं-√ रा (only pr. p. -रराण), to give liberally, bestow, grant, RV.; VS.; AV.
सं-√ राध् Caus. -राधयति (pr. p. -राधयत्, q.v.), to agree together, agree about or upon (loc.), TS.; Kāṭh.; to conciliate, appease, satisfy, BhP.
a: संराध् — {c4c} P. 1 To be accomplished or perfected. --2 To be acquired. --Caus. 1 To bring into harmony. --2 To agree about or upon (with acc.) --3 To propitiate, satisfy, conciliate.

m: सं-राधक mfn. practising complete concentration of mind, thoroughly concentrated, Bādar.

v: na॰ sam + rADa--lyuw । 1 savyak mevane 2 samyak cintane ca ।
m: सं-˚राधन mfn. (सं-) conciliating, satisfying, ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.
सं-˚राधन n. the act of conciliating or pleasing by worship, W.
perfect concentration of mind, meditation, Bādar.
shouting, applause, Jātakam.
a: संराधनं — 1 Propitiation, conciliation, pleasing by worship. --2 Accomplishing. --3 Profound or deep meditation.

m: सं-राधयत् mfn. (fr. Caus.) agreeing together, being in harmony, AV.
सं-˚राधित mfn. propitiated, appeased, conciliated, W.
सं-˚राध्य mfn. to be conciliated, BhP.
to be appropriated, ib.
to be acquired by perfect meditation, Śaṃk.
सं-राद्ध mfn. accomplished, acquired, obtained, BhP.
सं-˚राद्धि f. accomplishment, success, Dhātup.
सं-राग m. redness, R.
passion, vehemence, ib.
attachment to (loc.), Prāyaśc.
a: संरागः — 1 Colouring. --2 Passion, affection. --3 Rage, anger.

m: सं-√ राज् P. -राजति (inf. -राजितुम्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 25, Sch.), to reign universally, reign over (gen.), RV. (cf. सम्-राज्).
सं-राजितृ mfn., Pāṇ. viii, 3, 25, Sch.

s: puM, (saM + ru la DvanO + “upasargeruvaH .” 3 । 3 । 22 । iti GaY .) SabdaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 3 । 342 । “tatastasya saritpAte muktasaMrAvamagrataH । UrdDvabAhurmahadBUtaM prAdurAsIt mahOjasaH ॥”)
m: सं-राव &c. See सं-√ रु.
सं-राव m. crying together, clamour, uproar, tumult, Rājat.
a: संरावः — 1 Clamour, tumult, uproar. --2 Sound or noise in general.

m: सं-˚रावण n. id., Caṇḍ.
सं-˚राविन् mfn. shouting together, clamouring, roaring, W.
सं-√ री P. -रिणाति, to join together, restore, repair, RV.; KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; to wash, purify, VS.

s: tri, (saM + ruha + ktaH .) prOQaH । aNkuritaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate ॥ 12 । 228 । 2 । “tanno manasi saMrUQaM karizyAmastaTA ca tat ॥”
v: tri॰ sam + ruha--kta । 1 prOQe 2 jAtANkure ca medi॰ ।
m: सं-रूढ mfn. grown, sprung up, sprouted, Ragh.
grown over, cicatrized, healed, MBh.; R.
burst forth, appeared, Hariv.
growing fast or taking root firmly, MBh.
confident, bold (= प्रौढ), L.
a: संरूढ — p. p. 1 Grown together. --2 Cicatrized, healed; as in संरूढव्रण. --3 Shot forth, sprouted, budded, germinated; R. 6. 47. --4 Firmly grown, striking firm root. --5 Bold, confident.

m: सं-रूढ—व्रण mfn. having a healed or cicatrized wound, R.
सं-√ रूष् Caus. -रोषयति, (?), to spread over, smear, cover, Suśr.

सं-√ रभ् Ā. -रभते, (pr. p. -रम्भमाण, MW.; Impv. -रम्भस्व, Bālar.), to seize or take hold of, mutually grasp or lay hold of (for dancing &c.), grasp, grapple each other (in fighting &c.), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to get possession of (instr.), R.; to grow excited, fly into a passion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संरभ् — {c1c} A. 1 To become agitated, be overwhelmed or affected. --2 To be exasperated or furious, be enraged or irritated (mostly in p. p.); R. 16. 16. --3 To seize, catch hold of (Ved.)

संरंभः — 1 Beginning. --2 Turbulence, impetuosity, violence; हंत वर्धंते ते संरंभः Ś. 7. --3 Agitation, excitement, flurry; Ku. 3. 48; Māl. 6. 10. --4 Energy, zeal, ardent desire; R. 12. 92. --5 Anger, rage, wrath; प्रणिपातप्रतीकारः संरंभो हि महात्मनां R. 4. 64; 12. 36; V. 2. 21; 4. 28; Ku. 3. 76. --6 Pride, arrogance. --7 Swelling with heat and inflammation. --Comp. --परुष a. harsh through rage. --रस a. excessively enraged. --वेगः the impetuosity of anger.
संरंभिन् — a. (णी f.) 1 Excited, agitated, flurried; Śi. 2. 67. --2 Angry, furious, enraged. --3 Proud, arrogant.
संरंज् — {c4c} U. 1 To be dyed or coloured, to redden. --2 To be affected with any passion. --Caus. 1 To dye, colour. --2 To please, satisfy, gratify.

m: सं-√ रञ्ज् Ā. रज्यते, to be dyed or coloured, become red, MBh.; to be affected with any passion, MW. : Caus. -रञ्जयति, to colour, dye, redden (see -रञ्जित); to please, charm, gratify, BhP.
सं-˚रञ्जनीय mfn. to be rejoiced at, delightful, Divyāv.
सं-रञ्जन mf(ई)n. gratifying, charming, pleasant, SaddhP.
सं-˚रञ्जित mfn. coloured, dyed, reddened, Hariv.
सं-रब्ध mfn. mutually grasped or laid hold of, joined hand in hand, closely united with (instr. ; अम् ind.), AV.; ChUp.; MBh.
agitated excited, R.; enraged, furious, exasperated against (प्रति; n. impers.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
angry (as speech), Daś.; Sāh.
increased, augmented, MBh.; Rājat.
swelled, swelling, R.; Suśr.
overwhelmed, MW.
a: संरब्ध — p. p. 1 Excited, agitated. --2 Inflamed, exasperated, enraged, furious. --3 Augmented. --4 Swelled. --5 Overwhelmed. --6 Closely joined, hand in hand.

m: सं-रब्धम् (अम्), ind.
सं-रब्ध—मान mfn. one whose pride is excited, MBh.
सं-रब्ध—नेत्र mfn. having swollen eyes, ib.
सं-रब्ध—तर mfn. more or most excited or angry, R.
सं-रक्त mfn. coloured, red, R.
inflamed, enamoured (in अ-संर्˚), Hariv.
charming, beautiful, R.; Megh.
angry, W.
a: संरक्त — p. p. 1 Coloured, red. --2 Impassioned fired with passion. --3 Angry, irritated, inflamed with anger. --4 Enamoured, charmed. --5 Charming, beautiful.

m: सं-रक्त—लोचन mfn. having the eyes reddened (with passion or fury). (MW.)
सं-रक्त—नयन mfn. having the eyes reddened (with passion or fury). (R.)
सं-√ रक्ष् P. Ā. -रक्षति, ˚ते, to protect, guard, watch over, defend, preserve, save from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to keep, secure, MBh.; Kathās.
a: संरक्ष् — {c1c} P. 1 To protect. --2 To ward off, prevent.

m: सं-रक्षा f. guard, care, protection, MBh.; Kathās.
सं-रक्ष mfn. guarding, a guardian (cf. सांरक्ष्य), g. पुरोहितादि
a: संरक्षः — Protection, care, preservation.

m: सं-˚रक्षणीय mfn. to be protected, to be guarded against, R.
सं-˚रक्षण n. the act of guarding or watching, custody, preservation, protection of (gen. or comp.) or from (comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
prevention, Suśr.
a: संरक्षणं — 1 Protection, preservation. --2 Charge, custody.

m: सं-˚रक्षण—वत् mfn. taking care of, having regard for (comp.), Car.
सं-˚रक्षक m. (and f(इका). ), a keeper, guardian (cf. शालि-संरक्षिका).
सं-˚रक्षिन् mfn. one who guards, a guardian, keeper (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Hariv. (cf. सत्य-रक्षिन्).
सं-˚रक्षित mfn. protected, preserved, taken care of Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं-˚रक्षितव्य mfn. to be preserved or guarded or taken care of MW.
सं-˚रक्षितिन् mfn. one who has guarded &c. (with loc.) g. इष्टादि.
सं-˚रक्ष्य mfn. to be guarded or protected from (abl.), Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
to be guarded against or prevented, Car.; Kathās.
सं-√ रम् Ā. -रमते, to be delighted, find pleasure in (loc.), Bhaṭṭ.; to have carnal pleasure or sexual intercourse with (साकम्), BhP.

s: puM, (saM + raBa + GaY । num .) kroDaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 4 । 166 । “tAqayitvA tfRenApi saMramBAt matipUrvvakam । ekaviMSatimAjAtIH pApayonizu jAyate ॥”) AwopaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (samBramaH ॥ yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 6 । 24 । “na saMramBeRa siDyanti sarvvArTAH sAntvayA yaTA ॥”) vegaH । yaTA, tatrEva । 8 । 11 । 45 । “saMyamya manyusaMramBaM mAnayanto munervvacaH । upagIyamAnAmucarEryayuH sarvve trivizwapam ॥”) utsAhaH । yaTA, -- “kAryyAramBezu saMramBaH sTeya utsAha izyate .” iti sAhityadarpaRe 3 paricCedaH ॥
v: pu॰ sam + raBa--GaY--mum ca । 1 kope Sabdara॰ । 2 Awope tridvA॰ । 3 latsAhe medi॰ 4 vege ca “avrzwisaMramBamiDAmbuham” iti kumAraH ।
m: सं-रम्भ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) the act of grasping or taking hold of MBh. iv, 1056 (C.)
vehemence, impetuosity, agitation, flurry, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
excitement, zeal, eagerness, enthusiasm, ardent desire for or to (inf. or comp.), Kāv.; Rājat.
anger, fury, wrath against (loc. or उपरि with gen.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
angriness (i.e.) inflammation or irritation of a sore or wound, Suśr.
pride, arrogance, W.
intensity, high degree (ibc. = ‘intensely’), Kāv.; Kathās.
the brunt (of battle), Rājat.
beginning (= आ-रम्भ), MW.
सं-˚रम्भण mfn. stirring, exciting (applied to the hymns, AV. iv, 31 &c.), Kauś.
सं-रम्भ—दृश् mfn. having inflamed or angry eyes, BhP.
सं-रम्भ—परुष mfn. harsh from rage, intensely or exceedingly harsh or rough, W.
सं-रम्भ—रूक्ष mfn. exceedingly harsh or cruel, Vikr. iii, 20
सं-रम्भ—रस mfn. having angry or impetuous feelings, ib.
सं-रम्भ—ताम्र m. f. red with fury, ib.
सं-रम्भ—वत् mfn. wrathful, angry, Harav.
सं-रम्भ—वेग m. the violence or impetuosity of wrath, MW.
सं-˚रम्भिन् mfn. angry (as a sore), inflamed, irritable, Suśr.
ardently devoted to (comp.), MBh.
wrathful, furious, angry, irascible, MBh.; R.; BhP.
proud, W.
सं-˚रम्˚भि-ता f. agitation, wrath, fury, Kāv.
pride, MW.
सं-˚रम्˚भि-त्व n. agitation, wrath, fury, Kāv.
pride, MW.
सं-√ रेज् Ā. -रेजते, to be greatly agitated, tremble, quake, ŚBr.
सं-√ रिह् (Vedic form of सं-√ लिह् See √ रिक्; only pr. p. -रिहाण), to lick affectionately, caress (as a cow its calf), RV. iii, 33, 3.

a: संरिहाणं — Affectionately licking (as a cow licking her calf).

s: puM, (saM + ruDa + GaY .) roDanam । (yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 73 । 2 । “kzutkzAmAH SuzkavadanAH saMroDaparikarSitAH dadfSuste GanaSyAmaM pItakOSeyavAsasam ॥”) kzepaH । iti medinI ॥
v: pu॰ sama + ruDa--GaY । 1 roDane 2 kzepe ca medi॰ ।
m: सं-रोध m. complete obstruction or opposition, restraint, hindrance, stop, prevention, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
limitation, restriction, Lāṭy.
shutting up, confinement, R.; Megh.
investment, siege, blockade, BhP.; Sāh.
injury, offence, harm, MBh.; Kām.
suppression, destruction, BhP.
throwing, sending (= क्षेप), L.
a: संरोधः — 1 Complete obstruction or impediment, hindrance, prevention, check. --2 Blockade, siege. --3 Bond, fetter. --4 Throwing, sending forth.

m: सं-˚रोधन n. complete obstruction, the act of stopping, checking, restraining, suppressing, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
fettering, confining, BhP.
a: संरोधनं — Obstructing, stopping.

m: सं-˚रोध्य mfn. to be restrained or confined, Car.
सं-रोदन n. weeping together or vehemently, wailing, lamenting, Suśr.
सं-रोह m. growing over, TS.
curing, healing, Suśr.
growing up, bursting forth or into view, appearance, BhP.
सं-˚रोहण n. growing over, cicatrizing, healing, R.
(fr. Caus.) sowing, planting, Mālav. i, 8 (v.l.)
सं-˚रोहण mfn. healing, curing, Suśr.
सं-˚रोहिन् mfn. growing up or in (comp.), Kāvyād.
सं-रोपण mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing to grow over or heal, Suśr.
planting, sowing, Kāv.; VarBṛS.
सं-˚रोपित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to grow, planted, implanted (fig. ‘in the womb’), Śak. vi, 23.
सं-रोषित mfn. spread over, covered, besmeared, ib.
सं-√ रु P. -रौति, to cry together, shout, roar, Bhaṭṭ.

सं-√ 2. रुध् P. Ā. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, to stop completely, detain, obstruct, check, confine, ŚBr. &c. &c.; to block up (a road), MBh.; to invest, besiege, Hariv.; R. &c.; to shut up (the mind from external objects), MBh.; to keep off, avert, impede, prevent, ib.; to withhold, refuse, ib. : Caus. -रोधयति (only ind.p. -रोध्य), to cause to stop, obstruct, Rājat.
सं-रुध् f. a term used in gambling (prob. ‘a kind of stake’), AV.
a: संरुध् — {c7c} U. 1 To obstruct, detain, stop; स चेत्तु पाथ संरुद्धः पशभिर्वा रथेन वा Ms. 8. 295. --2 To impede, obstruct, prevent; रांरुद्धचेष्टस्य R. 2. 43. --3 To hold fast, enchain; तृणमिव लघु लक्ष्मीर्नैव तान् संरुणद्धि Bh. 2. 17. --4 To seize upon, grasp, catch hold of; Ms. 8. 235. --5 To besiege, blockade, invest. --6 To cover up, conceal. --7 To withhold, refuse.

m: सं-√ रुच् Ā. रोचते, to shine together or at the same time or in rivalry, RV.; VS.; ŚBr.; to shine, beam, glitter, BhP. : Caus. -रोचयति, to find pleasure in (acc.), like, approve, choose anything for (two acc.), resolve on (inf.), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
सं-रुद्ध mfn. stopped completely, detained, obstructed, hindered &c.
surrounded by (comp.), Mn.; BhP.
held, closed, Kathās.
invested, besieged, R.
covered, concealed, obscured, MBh.; R.
stopped up, filled with, R.; Kathās.; BhP.
withheld, refused, Nir.
a: संरुद्ध — p. p. 1 Checked, impeded, opposed. --2 Blocked up, filled up. --3 Blockaded, invested, besieged. --4 Covered over, concealed. --5 Refused, withheld.

m: सं-रुद्ध—चेष्ट mfn. one whose motion is impeded, Ragh.
सं-रुद्ध—प्रजनन mfn. one who is hindered from having offspring, Nir. v, 2.
सं-रुग्ण mfn. broken to pieces, shattered, Rājat.
a: संरुग्ण — p. p. Shattered, broken to pieces.

m: सं-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to grow together, grow up, increase, Kāv.; to grow over, be cicatrized, heal, TS. &c. &c.; to break forth, appear, Hariv.; Sāh. : Caus. -रोपयति, to cause to grow or increase, plant, sow, Bhartṛ.; BhP.; to cause to grow over or cicatrize, Suśr.; -रोहयति See सं-रोहण below.
a: संरुह् — {c1c} P. 1 To grow, increase. --2 To grow over, heal; see रुह्.

m: सं-√ रुज् P. -रुजति, to break to pieces, shatter, crush, RV.
सं-रुजन n. pain, ache, Car.
सं-√ रुष् Caus. -रोषयति (Pass. pr. p. -रोष्यमाण), to enrage, irritate, MBh.
सं-रुषित mfn. enraged, irritated, angry, ib.
